correctness.rationale: Explicit invariant derived from coprime modular divisibilities; t is a nonnegative integer. Vieta conjugation gives a smaller positive integer pair preserving t even if later coprimality fails; terminal pairs force t=0. The unique difference parameterization and gcd parity tests give the exact iff statement. Direct exact-integer verifier independently reproduces cases, not an infinite certificate.

value.rationale: A natural and complete classification at the first positive constant perturbation of a current reciprocal-prime-cycle problem. The rigid constant-one graph has no nontrivial two-cycles; the constant-two graph admits infinitely many coprime integer two-cycles, and the theorem identifies precisely the simultaneous quadratic primality condition governing its prime two-cycles. It determines the entire structural stratum, not a finite table or minor parameter improvement; infinitude of the prime subfamily remains open.
